# Hiring Record — synthetic recruiting record demo

Hiring Record is a local, synthetic demonstration of a versioned hiring standard, assessments, evidence, report refusals and a hash-chained event history. It is not a production recruiting system and contains no real candidates.

## Entry points

- Workspace: /record/
- Simulation lab: /lab/
- Offline bundle verifier: /verify/
- Developer guide: /developers/
- OpenAPI 3.1 description: /openapi.json
- MCP Streamable HTTP: /mcp (read-only; synthetic data)
- Agent setup: /agent.md

## Important behavior

Dismissing proposal B leaves assessments current. Approving it activates B2 and older assessments become stale; an already-open interview keeps its original rubric. A report can preserve a descriptive count while refusing a predictive claim. A receipt is pending until acknowledged, and Northwind has no sync operation.

The server is a local demo. PostgreSQL mode persists synthetic event streams; memory mode does not. Signed JSON bundles contain a temporary demo public key; a matching signature does not establish signer identity or the truth of evidence. Source documents are not included in the bundle.
